raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\int (\boldsymbol {a} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\boldsymbol {b} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi = \frac {4 \pi}{3} (\boldsymbol {a} \cdot \boldsymbol {b})
$$

(积分区域范围为 $\begin{array} { r }  0 < \bar { \theta ^ { } } < \pi , 0 < \phi < 2 \pi \} \end{array}$ ).利用该结果证明:对 $\ell = 0$ 态，

$$
\left\langle \frac {3 (\boldsymbol {S} _ {\mathrm {p}} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\boldsymbol {S} _ {\mathrm {e}} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) - \boldsymbol {S} _ {\mathrm {p}} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {\mathrm {e}}}{r ^ {3}} \right\rangle = 0,
$$

提示 $\hat { r } = \sin \theta \cos \phi \hat { i } + \sin \theta \sin \phi \hat { j } + \cos \theta \hat { k }$ 首先进行角积分运算.
raw_problem.solution_text:
证明

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int (\boldsymbol {a} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\boldsymbol {b} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = \int \left(a _ {x} \sin \theta \cos \phi + a _ {y} \sin \theta \sin \phi + a _ {z} \cos \theta\right) \left(b _ {x} \sin \theta \cos \phi \right. \\ + b _ {y} \sin \theta \sin \phi + b _ {z} \cos \theta) d \theta d \phi \\ = \int a _ {x} b _ {x} \sin^ {3} \theta \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi + \int a _ {y} b _ {y} \sin^ {3} \theta \sin^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ + \int a _ {z} b _ {z} \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi + \int \left(a _ {x} b _ {y} + a _ {y} b _ {x}\right) \sin^ {3} \theta \sin \phi \cos \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ + \int \left(a _ {x} b _ {z} + a _ {z} b _ {x}\right) \sin^ {2} \theta \cos \theta \cos \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ + \int \left(a _ {y} b _ {z} + a _ {z} b _ {y}\right) \sin^ {2} \theta \cos \theta \sin \phi \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi . \\ \end{array}
$$

由于 $\int _ { 0 } ^ { 2 \pi } \cos \phi \mathrm { d } \phi = \int _ { 0 } ^ { 2 \pi } \sin \phi \mathrm { d } \phi = \int _ { 0 } ^ { 2 \pi } \sin \phi \cos \phi \mathrm { d } \phi = 0 ,$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int (\boldsymbol {a} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\boldsymbol {b} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \\ = a _ {x} b _ {x} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \cos^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi + a _ {y} b _ {y} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {3} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \sin^ {2} \phi \mathrm {d} \phi \\ + a _ {z} b _ {z} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \cos^ {2} \theta \sin \theta d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} d \phi \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= \frac {4}{3} \pi \left(a _ {x} b _ {x} + a _ {y} b _ {y} + a _ {z} b _ {z}\right) = \frac {4}{3} \pi (\boldsymbol {a} \cdot \boldsymbol {b}).
$$

利用以上结呆 $\ell = 0$ 态不依赖 $\theta , \phi$ 所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \frac {3 (\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\boldsymbol {S} _ {e} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) - \boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e}}{r ^ {3}} \right\rangle \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{r ^ {3}} | \psi | ^ {2} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r \left[ \int 3 \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \hat {r}\right) \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {e} \cdot \hat {r}\right) \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi - \int \boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \right] \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{r ^ {3}} | \psi | ^ {2} r ^ {2} d r \left[ 4 \pi \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e}\right) - \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e}\right) \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \sin \theta d \theta d \phi \right] \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{r ^ {3}} | \psi | ^ {2} r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r \left[ 4 \pi \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e}\right) - 4 \pi \left(\boldsymbol {S} _ {p} \cdot \boldsymbol {S} _ {e}\right) \right] = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以，对 $\ell = 0$ 态，

$$
\left\langle \frac {3 (\pmb {S} _ {p} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) (\pmb {S} _ {e} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}}) - \pmb {S} _ {p} \cdot \pmb {S} _ {e}}{r ^ {3}} \right\rangle = 0.
$$
